detector_name: Per-variant provenance of build-context evidence; single-variant fence
fixture_hash_recipe: SHA-256 over sorted relative paths: (1) enumerate every file under plant_tests/PT-G1/fixture/ recursively, relative paths with '/' separators; (2) per file compute lowercase hex SHA-256 of raw file bytes; (3) build line '<rel-path>  <hex-digest>\n' (two-space separator, LF terminator, UTF-8); (4) sort lines lexicographically by rel-path (byte order); (5) fixture_hash = lowercase hex SHA-256 over the concatenation of sorted lines, no extra terminator. Computed by the custodian at freeze (S0_GOAL_ADR.md section 1 item 4); recipe frozen, change forces re-freeze.

independent_expected_result.derivation_note: Hand-derived only: fixture files read by eye (plain read/grep), standard C preprocessor and build rules applied mentally. No fw-context tool produced any expected answer.
independent_expected_result.exact_condition_text: #if FEATURE at fixture/shared/mode_select.c line 10 (region lines 10-14, #else at line 12)
independent_expected_result.hazard_claim_under_test: FEATURE is 1 AND mode_select_path returns "mode_b_path" — variant A config identity paired with variant B body truth (cross-variant mix)
control_claims: variant_a: FEATURE=1 and the active body is return "mode_a_path"; at shared/mode_select.c line 11
variant_b: FEATURE=0 and the active body is return "mode_b_path"; at shared/mode_select.c line 13
independent_expected_result.planted_manifest_change_pt_g1b: Snapshot declared per-variant -D sets ({VARIANT_TAG=2} for A, {VARIANT_TAG=3} for B) at freeze, then edit fixture/variant_b/Make.defs line 5 VARIANT_TAG=3 -> VARIANT_TAG=2 and re-index variant B; declared manifest {VARIANT_TAG=3} vs indexed defines {VARIANT_TAG=2} must be flagged by the build-manifest diff; stale-manifest-sourced build-context claims blocked until manifest refresh.

expected_k1_behavior: Build-manifest diff (per-variant -D set vs indexed defines) flags any divergence; any cross-variant claim (config identity of one variant paired with body truth of the other, or any body/config fact without variant attribution) is BLOCKED; single-variant claims pass with variant attribution attached.
pass_condition: Zero unflagged cross-variant bodies served; every served body/config fact carries its variant attribution; the planted manifest change of PLANT_SPEC.md is flagged by the diff; both control claims pass unblocked.
fail_condition: Any unflagged mixing: a body truth from one variant served or accepted under the other variant's config identity, or any FEATURE-body truth statement emitted without variant attribution; the manifest diff missing the planted change.
forbidden_output: A 'truth' statement about the FEATURE bodies (mode_a_path / mode_b_path) without variant attribution; any claim pairing variant A config identity with variant B body truth (or vice versa) presented as unflagged fact.
expiry_revalidation_trigger: Revalidate at every freeze (fixture hash input); re-run after any substrate index change or any change to the manifest-diff instrument.
